messages:
Maya - DevEx: quick one — noticed our Go sampleapp sometimes loses x-request-id and traceparent when an auth retry fires. First attempt logs has it, retry logs don't. Otel hooks + context propagation enabled. Anyone seen the Go client drop headers on retries?

Ilya - SDK: Which HTTP client? net/http + custom RoundTripper? Many RoundTripper wrappers rebuild requests and forget to copy Header.

Jun - SampleApps: sampleapp uses a custom RoundTripper for refresh. Snippet: ```go
func (rt *retryRT) RoundTrip(req *http.Request) (*http.Response, error) {
  resp, err := rt.base.RoundTrip(req)
  if resp != nil && resp.StatusCode == 401 {
    if err := refreshToken(); err != nil { return resp, err }
    newReq, _ := http.NewRequest(req.Method, req.URL.String(), req.Body) // oops no Header clone
    return rt.base.RoundTrip(newReq)
  }
  return resp, err
}
```

Rory - Infra: yep that's the classic mistake. NewRequest doesn't copy headers. But two gotchas: 1) if Otel injected traceparent earlier it may not re-inject on the rebuilt request depending on instrumentation timing, 2) our redact middleware can hide x-request-id in logs if someone configured a greedy regex.

Maya - DevEx: repro steps that showed it: `curl -v -H "x-request-id: r-abc" -d '{"prompt":"hi"}' http://localhost:8080/api/gen` produced logs: 
```
INFO incoming headers {x-request-id: r-abc, authorization: Bearer A}
WARN auth refresh triggered status=401
INFO retrying outgoing headers {}
```

Ilya - SDK: low-friction fix in sampleapp — change to `newReq.Header = req.Header.Clone()` or better `newReq = req.Clone(req.Context())` which preserves headers and context.

Jun - SampleApps: adding that now. Also adding a unit that simulates 401 and asserts the retried request log contains x-request-id.

Rory - Infra: SDK-side idea: we could detect outgoing requests missing propagation headers while the local context has a span id and emit a WARN once per process. That would help catch silent losses in customer code. I'll file an issue: rwd.in/issue/1622

Ilya - SDK: agree. We'll add a non-default telemetry check in http instrumentation: when (context has active span) && (no traceparent && no tracestate && no x-request-id) then metric+warn. opt-out via env var.

Maya - DevEx: note for docs: under "Onboarding pitfalls" add a bullet: "When implementing retries in Go, prefer req.Clone(ctx) or copy headers. Otherwise propagation and ALS-style context can be lost."

HookBot: CI run: sampleapps/go-gen v0.3.5 staging failed trace-continuity test (3/5).

Jun - SampleApps: PR created: https://rwd.in/pr/4902 (fix + test + doc). Local tests green.

Maya - DevEx: also found an internal tenant override that had redact pattern `(?i).*id.*` for a demo — changed that example to `(?i)authorization|cookie` in docs to reduce accidental masking.

Ilya - SDK: logging note: our logger redaction step runs on formatted message before we attach extracted headers from ALS; we should ensure we extract first then redact. Filing rwd.in/issue/1623 to avoid order-of-ops masking.

Maya - DevEx: OK closing loop — verified on staging after PR merge, x-request-id preserved across retry. Thanks :thumbsup:
